correctness.rationale: Exact Fourier Gram matrix fixes the diagonal; Schur-complement inverse inequality with equality rigidity proves the unique regular polygon. Radial log-risk has strictly positive second derivative (variance plus p e^t/(e^t-1)^2), opposite endpoint derivative signs and a unique root. The three regimes and sharp risk growth follow by a singular Riemann sum (1<p<2), an exact p=2 geometric-series stationarity equation, and Beta/Gamma endpoint Laplace estimates (p>2). Companion verify.py passed 278 finite diagnostics but is not used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: Exact minimum-total-coefficient-variance design with a fixed total normalized sensing budget and minimal sample count is intrinsically motivated by stable Bergman reconstruction. It rigorously identifies the angular optimizer, unique radial optimizer for every finite degree, and three qualitatively different large-degree radius/risk laws separated by the unweighted exponent. This is not a parameter substitution or fixed small-degree recomputation of the previous condition-number result.
